csbwin_combat_mechanics_research_2026110.source_graphic: graphics.dat graphic 0x230; 1055 compressed bytes, 1256 decompressed bytes
findings: Weapon damage depends on Strength, weight, mastery, stamina, armor, attack power and randomness.
Accuracy depends on Quickness/Dexterity, Luck and randomness; no separate conventional critical-hit multiplier.
Physical attacks can incur both attack-processing stamina and action-table stamina costs.
Temporary armor modifiers in Byte20090 are signed; Block +36, Parry +29.
Attack method cooldowns are in game ticks; throwing uses its own timing.
Skill experience is awarded for actions and combat circumstances; no separate kill XP bonus.

approved_decision.use: CSBwin corrected attribute-based damage calculation, not the reported Atari ST compiler bug
approved_decision.formula: if (170 - currentAttribute >= 16) damage = damage * (170 - currentAttribute) / 128; else damage = damage / 8; use integer arithmetic

reported_findings: 27 monster type records decoded; types 5 and 25 unnamed; 25 and 26 similar to Lord Chaos except graphic word zero.
Hit points calculated as baseHealth times generator multiplier plus random term.
No general path search: sight, smell, footprints and random legal steps drive movement.
Detection responds to facing, all-around sight, darkness, seeing in dark, invisibility; smell does not check invisibility.
Movement and attacks use game timers; Freeze Life delays non-invincible groups by 4 ticks; party sleep does not suspend monster timers.
One group record holds up to four members: size 0 has four, size 1 two, size 2 one.
Black Flame move time 255 prevents ordinary stepping; InitialChecks can substitute 100 when computing delays.
